text:
maria: Quick check — I'm lining up the quiet window for tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Can folks do a fast pass on the 'offramp walkthrough' (rollback runbook) and confirm who will be on the lightswitch/undo roster? We want owners for: DB toggle, frontend feature flag, canary control, and the actual undo operator.

kevin: On it. I'll skim the runbook now. For smoke, do we want the full e2e suite or a smaller smoke script?

sanjay: smaller smoke script only — aim for <3m per canary. Full e2e is too slow during rollout.

kevin: Agreed. I'll paste the smoke checklist I'm proposing:
```
- health /metrics OK on all pods
- 1 sample request through canary route (200, p95 < 400ms)
- sanity embeddings job passes on sample set
- no errors in logs with "warn" or higher
```

maria: perfect. Can someone own the DB toggle: who flips, who verifies?

elaine: I can own DB toggle verification. Who flips? I don't want to be flipping without a rollback contact.

jamal: I can be the lightswitch / undo operator — I have rollback access and will be on pager. I'll also own the `kubectl rollback` steps.

kevin: Jamal +1. Jamal, note the exact command in runbook:
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=<last-known-good>`
Also add: tag the commit as `rollback-<deploy-ts>` and create a short postmortem note if we revert.

jamal: noted. Who has the last-known-good revision handy? Ops-bot, can you show the last two revisions for api?

ops-bot: Scheduled query: `kubectl rollout history deployment/api --max=2` returned revisions 45, 44 (current 45).

kevin: ok so revert to 44 if needed. Also reminder: the feature flag for new routing is in `flags-service` -> flag `new_canary`. Make sure we have a quick TTL-based disable in case of config drift.

elaine: KMS rotation note: keys were rotated two days ago. Ensure the decryptor pod comes up in canary cluster before flipping DB toggle. I'll add a pre-check step: `curl -f http://decryptor.canary/health`

maria: good catch. I'll update the runbook with those prechecks and ping infra to validate key access.

kevin: small ask — please add an explicit step to snapshot the DB schema (pg_dump -s) before toggling. Even if we don't use it, it's a cheap safety.

maria: done. I'll also put the quiet-window alert in calendar and @channel 15m before.

jamal: I'm +1 to be the undo operator. I'll be online 10:45–12:00 UTC.

elaine: I'll be available for verification 10:50–12:10 UTC.

sanjay: I'll run the smoke script and watch metrics; available 10:45–11:30.

kevin: I'll standby for logs/tracing and help with roll-forward tests. 10:40–12:00.

maria: great — owners mapped: DB verify -> elaine, Flip operator -> ??? (need flipper), Undo operator -> jamal, Smoke -> sanjay, Logs/traces -> kevin. Who flips the DB toggle?

elaine: we should have the service owner flip. If none, I can do it but prefer product owner to trigger.

maria: product owner @alexis is OOO but said she'd be comfortable with a trusted eng flip. Alexis, can you confirm? (cc @alexis)

ops-bot: Reminder queued: quiet window notification will post to #eng-releases 15 minutes before 2026-03-18 11:00:00 UTC.

alexis: (via DM) I'm okay with eng flipping. elaine please go ahead.

maria: ack. Final checklist:
- prechecks (decryptor health, snapshot) -> elaine
- smoke run -> sanjay
- logs/tracing & roll-forward validation -> kevin
- undo operator (kubectl rollback + tag) -> jamal
- communications (cancel if > 3 failed smoke tries) -> maria

kevin: I added a short note about acceptable rollback criteria:
- error rate increase > 2x baseline for 5m OR
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 5m OR
- user-facing 5xxs > 0.5% over baseline for 5m
If any of these trigger, jamal should start the undo flow.

maria: thanks. If no objections I'll mark the runbook final and push the calendar. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

jamal: :raised_hands:

elaine: :ok_hand:

sanjay: good to go from my side.

maria: great — closing this thread. I'll post the runbook link after edits.
